title: Compact Decision Ladder + Scenario Simulations for Dedicated Capacity Onboarding
creator: Asha Menon
description: Create a compact, progressive-disclosure onboarding asset that guides users through capacity selection using a Decision Ladder visual combined with three simulated workload scenarios. The deliverables include annotated Figma frames, lightweight GIFs demonstrating autoscale behavior, export-ready PNG/SVG assets for the quickstart guide, and short microcopy strings for the Console UI (tooltips, helper text, and SLA summaries). This ticket focuses on design artifacts and dev handoff specs for the Dedicated product onboarding flow.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with at least 6 finished frames: overview ladder, persona chooser, autoscale preview, SLA compare modal, capacity recommendation card, and success screen
Three scenario simulations (bursty chat, high-throughput embeddings, mixed short/long requests) with token-per-second and cost callouts included in annotations
Annotated export-ready assets (PNG/SVG) and 2 GIFs that illustrate autoscale ramp and graceful degradation
Microcopy set (under 250 characters each) for tooltip, compact explainer, and SLA badge text, reviewed by PM
Handoff doc (Confluence) with dev notes: spacing tokens, responsive breakpoints, color tokens, and accessibility contrast checks
Design review approved by PM and Engineering (stated approvals in updates)
